create_Embedder_encode_decode: create an Embedder module that encodes token sequences into activations and decodes activations back into token logits
build_LocalAttentionBlock: build a LocalAttentionBlock with configurable width, num_heads, and window_size for local causal attention with KV-cache support
build_RecurrentBlock: build a RecurrentBlock with Griffin-Hawk RG-LRU and Conv1D layers for recurrent sequence processing with state caching
build_ResidualBlock: build a ResidualBlock that combines a temporal block (recurrent or attention) with an optional MLP block using pre-norm residual connections
test_LocalAttentionBlock_init_cache: test the LocalAttentionBlock.init_cache class method that initializes an empty KV-cache with specified batch size, window size, and head dimension
